findings.location: source.html, paragraph beginning “For God hath not given us…”
findings.source_quote: “For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “autocontrollo” in the quoted verse with an Italian rendering of “a sound mind,” such as “una mente sana” or “una mente equilibrata,” while leaving the reference –2Tm 1:7 unchanged.
findings.translation_quote: “Dio infatti non ci ha dato uno spirito di paura, ma di forza, d’amore e di autocontrollo –2Tm 1:7.”
